# MSMEVault.in
> Authoritative reference portal and utility platform for Indian MSME government schemes, loan comparisons, subsidies, business ideas, and compliance guides.

## Interactive Tools & Calculators
- [GST Calculator](https://msmevault.in/tools/gst-calculator): Reverse and forward GST calculator with CGST, SGST, IGST breakdown across all Indian tax slabs.
- [NIC Code Finder](https://msmevault.in/tools/nic-code-finder): Searchable directory of 500+ National Industrial Classification (NIC) codes for Udyam registration.
- [Mudra Loan Calculator](https://msmevault.in/tools/mudra-loan-calculator): Compute monthly EMI, interest, and amortisation for Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun loans.
- [MSME Subsidy Calculator](https://msmevault.in/tools/msme-subsidy-calculator): Calculate PMEGP margin money subsidies (15%-35%) based on category and region.

## Foundational Government Scheme Guides
- [Udyam Registration 2026: Complete Step-by-Step Guide and Free Application Process](https://msmevault.in/guides/udyam-registration): Step-by-step verified guide to free online Udyam Registration on udyamregistration.gov.in. Zero fees, Aadhaar OTP authentication, and lifetime certificate validity.
- [PM Mudra Yojana (PMMY) 2026: Loan Limits, Tarun Plus (₹20L) & Application Guide](https://msmevault.in/guides/mudra-loan): Verified breakdown of PM Mudra Loan categories (Shishu up to ₹50k, Kishor up to ₹5L, Tarun up to ₹10L, and Tarun Plus up to ₹20L w.e.f. Oct 2024). Eligibility & application steps.
- [PMEGP Subsidy Scheme 2026: 15%–35% Margin Money Grant & Project Ceilings](https://msmevault.in/guides/pmegp-loan): Comprehensive guide to Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP). Revised ₹50L manufacturing / ₹20L service project ceilings, subsidy matrix, and KVIC portal workflow.
- [CGTMSE Scheme 2026: Collateral-Free Bank Guarantee up to ₹10 Crore](https://msmevault.in/guides/cgtmse): Verified guide to CGTMSE credit guarantee cover up to ₹10 Crore (increased from ₹5 Cr w.e.f. 1 Apr 2025 per Circular 250). Eligibility, coverage ratio, and bank coordination.
- [New MSME Classification Limits 2026: Investment & Turnover Thresholds Explained](https://msmevault.in/guides/msme-classification-2026): Verified MSME definition per Gazette Notification S.O. 1364(E). Micro (₹2.5Cr / ₹10Cr), Small (₹25Cr / ₹100Cr), Medium (₹125Cr / ₹500Cr). Composite criteria explained.

## Verified Central and State Government Schemes
- [Udyam Registration (Official MSME Registration)](https://msmevault.in/schemes/pm-mudra-yojana-shishu): Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) Shishu tier provides collateral-free institutional credit up to ₹50,000 to micro-entrepreneurs, shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors, and artisanal units through commercial banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, and MFIs.
- [PM Mudra Yojana — Kishor](https://msmevault.in/schemes/pm-mudra-yojana-tarun): PMMY Tarun offers credit facilities from ₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh. Following the Department of Financial Services notification w.e.f. 24 October 2024, the 
- [CGTMSE (Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro & Small Enterprises)](https://msmevault.in/schemes/pmegp-scheme): PMEGP is a major credit-linked capital subsidy scheme implemented by KVIC. Subsidies range from 15% to 35% of total project cost (urban general 15%, rural general 25%, urban special 25%, rural special 35%). Project cost ceilings are ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakh for service/business units.
- [PM Vishwakarma Scheme](https://msmevault.in/schemes/msme-zed-certification): Encourages MSMEs to adopt Zero Defect Zero Effect manufacturing practices. Financial assistance includes up to 80% subsidy for Micro, 60% for Small, and 50% for Medium enterprises on certification cost (Bronze, Silver, Gold levels), plus ₹5 Lakh handholding support and ₹3 Lakh testing assistance.
- [PMFME (PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises)](https://msmevault.in/schemes/stand-up-india-scheme): Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield manufacturing, service, agri-allied, or trading enterprise.
- [Maharashtra Package Scheme of Incentives (PSI)](https://msmevault.in/schemes/gujarat-msme-scheme-incentives): Incentives under Gujarat Industrial Policy for micro, small, and medium enterprises. Provides capital subsidy of 10%–25% (up to ₹35 Lakh) on eligible plant & machinery and 5%–7% interest subsidy for up to 7 years.
- [Tamil Nadu NEEDS (New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development)](https://msmevault.in/schemes/up-msme-promotion-policy): Uttar Pradesh MSME policy offering 15% to 25% capital subsidy (cap ₹4 Crore in Bundelkhand/Purvanchal and ₹2 Crore in Western UP), 50% interest subsidy on loans up to ₹5 Crore, and 100% stamp duty exemption.
